item.title: Barbed wire hazard, 21st September
item.description:
Three strands of exposed barbed wire have been fixed across a gap in a fence at a cut-through at the top of Birdlip Road, Cheltenham GL52 5AJ (near plots 1 and 3), where a grass verge runs down from the road to the footpath on the east side of Birdlip Road. The wire is at low, middle and upper height, unmarked and unguarded, across a route regularly used by pedestrians, children and dogs to reach the footpath. It appears to have been placed deliberately by a resident, and the cut-through has been discussed on our estate residents' group. Please confirm the status of the footpath (whether it is a public right of way), establish who owns this land, and arrange removal of the barbed wire as a dangerous obstruction/hazard. Photographs attached. Happy to be contacted.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Birdlip Road, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
